title: INTERPLANE InputRecord
description: One piece of material placed in front of the model. Recorded by the runtime or the host, never by the model. `trust` is assigned by the runtime; a model cannot raise it.

source.description: Who handed the bytes to the context.

origin.description: Locator for where the bytes came from: file path, URL, memory record id, provider id or `runtime:<id>`. May be a digest-only form (`sha256:...`) for sensitive locators.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes shown to the model.

parent_id.description: The message_id or request_id that produced this input. Null for host-registered inputs.

derived_from.description: input_ids this input was computed from (summaries, nested content). May be empty.
